ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (creamy white) pixels across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity mass occupies the central and lower regions of both lobes. High-intensity pigmentation is localized in broad bands at the distal lobe tips and along the posterior margins, with discrete high-intensity punctate spots scattered across the dark central field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a wide aperture (calculated at approximately 130-140 degrees) and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; prominent jagged peaks and micro-notches are concentrated on the inner margins near the median notch and on the outer margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distal lobes exhibit a convex upward curvature with a tapered lateral sweep ending in rounded, barnacle-encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (yellow-white) indicating barnacle colonization localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe lobe; extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial distribution of small white circular spots (speckling) across the dark pigment of the left lobe ventral surface.
